title: CGDT-CESN: Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network for Multivariate Time-Series Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.22430v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate prediction of multivariate time series requires models that simultaneously capture variable-specific dynamics and cross-variable interactions. In this work, a Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network (CGDT-CESN) is proposed, which comprises a modular reservoir architecture with each cluster distinctly specializing in one of the variables in the multivariate time series. An innovative reservoir design is proposed in which inter-cluster connections are enabled by empirically observed correlations among variables, providing a data-driven coupling mechanism. Apart from conventional readout training, inter-cluster connection weights informed by correlations are trained, which in turn allows the reservoir to capture time-varying cross-variable dependencies without sacrificing computational efficiency and further improves forecasting accuracy. translated_title: CGDT-CESN：面向多元时间序列预测的相关性引导与动力学训练聚类回声状态网络
translated_abstract: 对多元时间序列的准确预测需要模型能够同时捕捉各变量自身的动态特性和变量间的交互作用。本研究提出了一种相关性引导与动力学训练的聚类回声状态网络（CGDT-CESN），该网络采用模块化储备池架构，其中每个聚类专门负责多元时间序列中的一个变量。研究提出了一种创新的储备池设计，聚类之间的连接由经验观测到的变量间相关性驱动，从而提供了一种数据驱动的耦合机制。除了常规的读出层训练之外，该模型还训练由相关性信息指导的聚类间连接权重，使储备池能够捕捉随时间变化的跨变量依赖关系，同时不牺牲计算效率，并进一步提高了预测精度。研究发现 CGDT-CESN 的预测性能优于……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种相关性引导与动力学训练的聚类回声状态网络（CGDT-CESN），通过基于变量间相关性构建并训练聚类间连接，在保持计算效率的同时捕捉时变的跨变量依赖关系，显著提升了多元时间序列的预测精度。
en_tdlr: The proposed CGDT-CESN, a correlation-guided and dynamics-trained clustered echo state network, builds and trains inter-cluster connections based on empirical variable correlations, capturing time-varying cross-variable dependencies while maintaining computational efficiency and improving multivariate time-series prediction accuracy.
